# NOTION-Knowledge Capture Framework

Apply the following notion-knowledge capture framework guidance to the code or configuration you are changing. Check the stated preconditions and preserve behavior outside the authorized scope.

- Skill: `notion-knowledge-capture`
- Source of truth: `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/notion/skills/notion-knowledge-capture/SKILL.md`
- Runtime agent config: `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/notion/skills/notion-knowledge-capture/agents/openai.yaml`
- Supporting docs: `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/notion/skills/notion-knowledge-capture/references/`
